dimensions.name: module_is_public_kit_escalate
dimensions.observation: Test passed. kit.escalate.__file__ resolves to kit/escalate.py under the repo root; source contains no email and none of the six profile names; deliver() requires architect and transport as keyword-only parameters with no default; deliver(self.record) alone raises TypeError.

dimensions.name: loop_does_not_call_the_architect
dimensions.observation: Test passed. kit/conductor_loop.py contains neither 'kit.escalate' nor 'import escalate'; escalate.deliver also ran with conductor_loop.loop replaced by an assertion-raising sentinel and the sentinel was never called across all delivery paths.

dimensions.name: broken_or_incomplete_architect_delivers_nothing
dimensions.observation: Test passed. All seven broken-architect shapes (raise, None, bare string, {}, blank text, whitespace text, null text) produced transport.call_count == 0, no delivered=True, no 'verified' label anywhere in the result or changed files, and the analysis text was written nowhere.

dimensions.name: delivers_architect_text_with_sha256_and_not_verified
dimensions.observation: Test passed. deliver() returned delivered=True with sha256 equal to hashlib.sha256 of the sent text, the transport received the text unchanged as first positional, architect and transport were each called once, the digest appears in some file under the record dir, and no 'verified' string appears in the result or any written file.

dimensions.name: retry_does_not_send_twice_or_rerun_rounds
dimensions.observation: Test passed. After a successful send, escalate was reloaded and deliver() was called again with a different architect and transport: the second transport was not called and the loop sentinel never fired, so the durable record prevents both a double send and a re-run of rounds.

dimensions.name: transport_failure_is_not_sent_twice
dimensions.observation: Test passed. The first transport raised RuntimeError and was called exactly once; after module reload a second transport was not called, so a failed send still counts as made and no retry re-sends.

dimensions.name: broken_run_does_not_consume_the_send
dimensions.observation: Test passed. A raising architect left transport.call_count == 0 with no send recorded; a later finished architect then sent once with delivered=True and the analysis text unchanged.

dimensions.name: decide_records_the_reply_and_does_not_touch_terminal_state
dimensions.observation: Test passed. decide(record_dir, reply) wrote the exact reply text into some file under the record dir while terminal_state in summary.json and escalation.json remained 'needs_owner' before and after, and no loop() call occurred.

dimensions.name: proposed_packet_ratified_is_not_delivered
dimensions.observation: Test passed. An architect run carrying a schema-valid ratified packet produced transport.call_count == 0 and no delivered=True result; the ratification check blocks delivery.

dimensions.name: proposed_packet_invalid_is_not_delivered
dimensions.observation: Test passed. An architect run carrying {"ratified": false} alone (which fails the Draft 2020-12 job-packet schema: 'entry' is a required property) produced transport.call_count == 0 and no delivered=True result; the validation check blocks delivery.

dimensions.name: proposed_packet_unratified_is_delivered_and_not_run
dimensions.observation: Test passed. An architect run carrying the schema-valid unratified fixture was delivered once (transport.call_count == 1, text unchanged, delivered=True, correct sha256) with no loop() call; the unratified packet rides along with the text and is never run.

dimensions.name: null_proposed_packet_is_not_present
dimensions.observation: Test passed. proposed_packet null is treated as not present: the run delivered once with delivered=True and correct sha256, and neither the result nor any written file carries a 'verified' label.
